info.text:
That 20% store card discount can cost more than it saves.
Bankrate's 2025 study: store cards averaged 30.14% APR vs 20.12% for all cards. The average peaked at a record 30.45% in 2024, up from 24.35% in 2021.
Our math: 20% off $500 saves $100. Carry the other $400 for a year at 30.14% and it's about $121 in interest (simple interest, approx.).
CFPB (Dec 2024): 90% of retail cards had max APRs above 30%. Small limits can push utilization up fast, and applying means a hard inquiry.
The discount happens once; interest repeats every month you carry a balance.
Sources: Bankrate Retail Cards Study 2025, CFPB, Experian.
News and education, not financial advice.
